The ideal candidate is a motivated team-player with deep technical expertise in Azure services and cloud computing, a passion for automation, and the ability to communicate complex architectural decisions to both technical and non-technical stakeholders. This position requires an active Secret clearance at minimum, with Top Secret preferred. This is for a future new business opportunity. Benefits include medical, dental, and vision insurance, 401(k) retirement plan, paid time off, paid parental leave, life and disability insurance, flexible spending accounts, commuter benefits and tuition reimbursement. Responsibilities The Senior Azure Engineer will serve on a focused, small team responsible for supporting and expanding Azure Cloud service offerings used by a federal agency to modernize and migrate systems to the cloud. This is a multi-functional role requiring both hands-on engineering expertise and the ability to collaborate closely with Product Owners, Scrum Masters, fellow engineers, and security engineers to define, build, and roadmap future cloud service releases. Principal responsibilities will include but are not limited to: Support the design, implementation, and ongoing management of Azure Cloud service offerings at both FISMA Moderate and FISMA High security levels. Work closely with the Product Owner, Scrum Master, engineers, and security engineers to define and build initial service offerings as well as the roadmap for future releases. Communicate architectural trade-offs and design options clearly so that the Product Owner and executive leadership can make informed, strategic decisions. Participate in and support a team charged with coordinating and implementing various solutions required to support the Azure Cloud environment. Implement proof of concepts and pilots for various cloud solutions and develop operational plans for supporting all developed solutions. Create documentation and implementation plans for various solutions used to access and leverage Azure. Build and support YAML-based CI/CD pipelines leveraging tools such as GitLab CI, GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps, Jenkins, CircleCI, or similar. Build and support Infrastructure as Code (IaC) solutions using tools such as Terraform, Pulumi, Ansible, Salt, Chef, CloudFormation, or similar. Develop and maintain PowerShell scripts utilizing logical constructs such as if/else, foreach, try/catch, and more. Partner with development and operations teams to develop practical automation solutions and custom modules, troubleshoot automation issues, and drive projects forward in a timely manner. Drive a culture of collaboration, transparency, and automation within the engineering team. Identify constraints and bottlenecks in engineering lifecycles and develop automated solutions to address them. Research, analyze, design, propose, and support the delivery of cloud solutions aligned with business and technology strategies. Support Change and Configuration Management best practices across the team. Operate within an Agile development environment, supporting Scrum and/or Kanban methodologies. Education And Experience Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Business Administration, Information Technology, or a related field from an accredited college or university. Microsoft Certified: Azure Administrator Associate Certificate (AZ-104). Microsoft Certified: Azure Developer Associate (AZ-204). Significant experience in Azure cloud engineering, administration, or architecture roles. Demonstrated experience working in or supporting a federal government IT environment. Active Secret Clearance or higher. Required Skills And Competencies Exceptional communication skills in English – both written and oral – with the ability to communicate effectively with technical and non-technical stakeholders, including executive leadership. Ability to set the technical tone and drive an Azure engineering team toward common infrastructure goals. Deep understanding of IaaS and PaaS services offered on Azure and the ability to leverage them together to build complex, enterprise-grade solutions. Experience building and supporting YAML-based CI/CD pipelines using tools such as GitLab CI, GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps, Jenkins, CircleCI, or equivalent. Experience building and supporting Infrastructure as Code (IaC) using tools such as Terraform, Pulumi, Ansible, Salt, Chef, CloudFormation, or equivalent. Proven experience with Terraform Open Source in CI/CD-driven solutions. Proven knowledge of PowerShell scripting with the ability to build and understand logical scripts utilizing constructs such as if/else, foreach, try/catch, etc. Experience with Cloud-Native and Hybrid cloud architectures.
